# Find and review past chats
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find a previous coding agent chat and inspect its files, dates, references, worktrees, and topics.

## Find a chat

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/chats/chats_header_and_sort.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/chats/chats_list.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/chats/past_chats_settings_section.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/ChatsPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/ChatsSortMenu.vue -->

Open **Past chats** in the sidebar and use its search and sort controls to find a chat. Select a chat to review its summary.

## Inspect chat details

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/chats/chat_summary.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/chats/information_cards/dates_line.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/chats/information_cards/files_line.md -->

<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/ChatFilesLine.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/ChatReferencesLine.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/ChatWorktreesLine.vue -->

Select a dates, files, references, or worktrees line in a chat summary to open its information card. Select a line again, press Escape, or click outside the card to close it. The files card provides actions for files that are available in the repository; the worktrees card can open an existing worktree as a workspace.

## Explore chat topics

Use the dynamic topics controls in Settings to choose how topics are found and shown for past chats. Keyword extraction stays on this computer; language model extraction uses the installed coding agent.
